description: Quote a buy (ETH in) or sell (tokens in) without building or sending anything. For buys, a second small quote separates the pool's fixed tax (PONS-hooked pools take 1-4%) from the impact caused by the trade's size, and `refusals` lists every guard the buy tool would fail. Caps: $10 per buy, $50 per 24h, size impact <= 300 bps, total impact <= 500 bps, 0.001 ETH kept for gas.

amount.description: Sell: exact token base units (or use percent).

amountEth.description: Buy: ETH to spend (or use usd).

percent.description: Sell: share of the holding to sell (default 100).

usd.description: Buy: USD to spend (or use amountEth).

name: quote
title: Quote a trade
